matches.rationale: No report finding covers the relayer paying gas for many small withdrawals and running out of ether.
Findings 3 and 11 discuss withdrawMsgIdProcessed, but neither identifies 64-bit id collisions. Finding 3 is about id reuse after deletion, and finding 11 is about storing block.number.
Finding 1 identifies the same defect: DeployV1 never grants WITHDRAW_AUTHORITY_ROLE to the bridge, so every claimWithdrawal reverts.
